name: @epoch/event-log
description: Epoch Event Log kernel — the authoritative append-only change history (W010): totally-ordered per-stream typed events carrying actor/tenant scoping, causal references, payload discriminators and content digests; strict monotonic sequence admission with gap/duplicate/tamper/cross-tenant rejection; deterministic in-memory cursor and read primitives. Events are immutable facts; corrections are new events, never mutations.
